provenance: Proposed course examples; not generated or student work.

entries.title: Photographic storytelling
entries.prompt: A small neighbourhood bakery on a quiet Lagos street, with a green door, a wooden bread display and a person buying a loaf, at sunrise. Warm editorial photography, natural colours, eye-level composition. Landscape 4:3. No logos or text.
entries.explanation: The subject and setting stay fixed; the photographic style makes the scene feel documentary.

entries.title: Watercolour storytelling
entries.prompt: A small neighbourhood bakery on a quiet Lagos street, with a green door, a wooden bread display and a person buying a loaf, at sunrise. Hand-painted watercolour illustration on textured paper, gentle brush strokes, eye-level composition. Landscape 4:3. No logos or text.
entries.explanation: Compare this painting with the photograph. Only the requested visual style changes.

entries.title: Paper-cut storytelling
entries.prompt: A small neighbourhood bakery on a quiet Lagos street, with a green door, a wooden bread display and a person buying a loaf, at sunrise. Layered paper-cut illustration with visible paper edges and a restrained green and ochre palette, eye-level composition. Landscape 4:3. No logos or text.
entries.explanation: The same scene becomes a graphic illustration through material and style instructions.

entries.title: Soft daylight
entries.prompt: A handmade terracotta coffee cup on a pale wooden table beside a folded cream linen napkin, against a plain warm-grey wall. Eye-level product photograph, identical composition and object placement. Soft diffused daylight from the left, gentle shadows and neutral colours. Landscape 4:3. No text or logos.
entries.explanation: Soft light reveals texture without a dramatic mood.

entries.title: Dramatic side light
entries.prompt: A handmade terracotta coffee cup on a pale wooden table beside a folded cream linen napkin, against a plain warm-grey wall. Eye-level product photograph, identical composition and object placement. One hard light from the left, deep shadows to the right, dramatic high contrast. Landscape 4:3. No text or logos.
entries.explanation: Direction remains the same; harder light creates stronger shadows.

entries.title: Warm evening light
entries.prompt: A handmade terracotta coffee cup on a pale wooden table beside a folded cream linen napkin, against a plain warm-grey wall. Eye-level product photograph, identical composition and object placement. Warm golden evening light from the left, soft amber highlights and long gentle shadows. Landscape 4:3. No text or logos.
entries.explanation: Warmer colour and lower light angle change the feeling of the same product.

entries.title: Establish the subject
entries.prompt: The same small red delivery bicycle with a cream wicker basket, a round brass bell on the left handlebar, black tyres and a brown leather saddle. Preserve these visual anchors and the bicycle geometry. Parked outside a neighbourhood bakery with a green door. Natural editorial photograph, eye-level view, soft daylight. Landscape 4:3. No text or logos.
entries.explanation: Establish the red frame, basket, bell and saddle before changing the setting.

entries.title: Change the scene
entries.prompt: The same small red delivery bicycle with a cream wicker basket, a round brass bell on the left handlebar, black tyres and a brown leather saddle. Preserve these visual anchors and the bicycle geometry. Parked beside a leafy city park, using the supplied bicycle reference image. Natural editorial photograph, eye-level view, soft daylight. Landscape 4:3. No text or logos.
entries.explanation: Use the first image as a reference and inspect whether the anchors survive.

entries.title: Check consistency again
entries.prompt: The same small red delivery bicycle with a cream wicker basket, a round brass bell on the left handlebar, black tyres and a brown leather saddle. Preserve these visual anchors and the bicycle geometry. Parked near a quiet seaside promenade, using the supplied bicycle reference image. Natural editorial photograph, eye-level view, soft daylight. Landscape 4:3. No text or logos.
entries.explanation: A third scene tests continuity; small differences should be discussed rather than hidden.

entries.title: Start a product composition
entries.prompt: A plain reusable sage-green water bottle with a rounded silver cap, on a pale stone pedestal. Soft studio photograph with several green leaves and textured fabric in the background. The bottle is centred. Landscape 4:3. No text, lettering or logos.
entries.explanation: This initial composition is the starting point for two deliberate edits.

entries.title: Edit the background
entries.prompt: Edit the supplied product photograph. Preserve the sage-green bottle, rounded silver cap, pedestal and their proportions. Remove the leaves and fabric, replace them with a simple warm-grey background, and move the bottle to the left third, leaving clear space on the right for a future headline. Keep the landscape 4:3 framing. Do not add text or logos.
entries.explanation: First edit: simplify distractions and make space for a landing-page headline.

entries.title: Refine the light
entries.prompt: Edit the supplied simplified product photograph. Preserve the sage-green bottle, rounded silver cap, pedestal, warm-grey background and left-third placement. Soften the shadows and add a subtle warm highlight along the left edge of the bottle. Keep the empty right-hand space and landscape 4:3 framing. Do not add text or logos.
entries.explanation: Second edit: refine lighting while preserving the composition already achieved.
